about: WRITTEN by the JS authority, never by hand. Each case: the chart bar times, the daily bar times, and `at`, the daily bar each chart bar shows (-1: none). ast_interpret.daily_read_placement is asserted equal to it.

cases.name: five-minute, a holiday, every daily bar final
cases.why: each bar of a day shows the day before it (the holiday has no bar on either side, so the Tuesday after it shows the Friday)

cases.name: five-minute, the clock change
cases.why: the New York date decides, whatever the UTC offset

cases.name: five-minute, a half day
cases.why: the half day's 13:00 close ends its bars; the day after shows the half day

cases.name: sixty-minute bars, milliseconds
cases.why: a bar time in milliseconds is the same instant

cases.name: daily bars spelled YYYYMMDD
cases.why: the store's daily key reads as its date

cases.name: the daily bars skip a day the chart has
cases.why: from the day after the missing one the daily bars are BEHIND (the chart's previous day is the witness): nothing is shown, and stale is said

cases.name: the daily bars start after the chart
cases.why: a chart bar whose finished day is before the first daily bar shows nothing

cases.name: the newest daily bar is today's, not proven final
cases.why: today's bars show yesterday, which is final; the newest daily bar (today's, forming) is shown on no bar

cases.name: the newest daily bar is yesterday's, not proven final
cases.why: today's bars would show the newest daily bar, which is not proven finished: nothing is shown, and stale is said
